heroTitle: Turn trust into growth with Check A Review
heroSubtitle: Plans built like a modern review platform: collect feedback, showcase TrustScore, and convert trust into demand.
billingNote: Paid plans are priced and billed monthly in GBP.

steps.title: Pick your plan
steps.description: Start with Starter, grow into Plus, or upgrade to Premium for richer insights.

steps.title: Collect more reviews
steps.description: Send monthly invitations within your plan quota and follow up with customers.

steps.title: Showcase trust
steps.description: Embed widgets on your allowed domains and match your public profile to your brand.

steps.title: Learn and improve
steps.description: Use analytics and, on higher plans, richer dashboards plus a customer success manager.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Start growing trust. One website — for small businesses getting started with reviews.
features: 2 widgets to collect reviews and showcase trust
Power your ads with Check A Review marketing assets
notes: Designed for small businesses (up to $5M revenue).

plans.name: Plus
plans.description: Turn trust into demand. Up to 3 websites — for businesses growing review volume across domains.
features: 10 widgets to collect reviews and showcase TrustScore
Power your ads with Check A Review marketing assets
Match your public profile to your brand

plans.name: Premium
plans.description: Make feedback your competitive edge. Unlimited domains — for larger teams that need richer data and support.
features: 21 widgets to showcase TrustScore and testimonials
Power your ads with Check A Review marketing assets
Match your public profile to your brand
More dashboards with richer data, insights, and trends

faqs.question: Are prices billed monthly or annually?
faqs.answer: Prices are shown per month in GBP and billed monthly.

faqs.question: Does Plus include a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plus includes a 14-day free trial for new customers before monthly billing begins.

faqs.question: How do I get Premium?
faqs.answer: Choose Premium from the business portal subscription page and complete Square checkout.

faqs.question: Can I change plans later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upgrade any time from the business portal. Downgrading to Free cancels the paid Square subscription.
